pedidos.instruccion_en: Apply a light blur (about 20% strength) only to the small word "amua" printed on the product: the one at the top of the yellow box and the one at the top of the bottle label. It should look softly out of focus but still be faintly visible, not erased. Keep everything else exactly the same: the "VITALDROPS" name and all other label text sharp, the bottle, box, headline, the four day panels, the woman, the gold offer box, the logo, layout, colors and fonts unchanged.
pedidos.resumen: Difuminamos un poco (cerca de un 20 %) la palabra «amua» de la caja y del frasco. Todo lo demás queda igual.
